analyst_view.overall: Osasuna, back under Jagoba Arrasate, are 15th and rely heavily on Budimir (8 goals). Aimar Oroz and Jorge Herrando are out rather than doubtful, as several reports confirm. Edin Terzić's Athletic have won three league games in a row but have only Iñaki Williams as a fit senior striker, since Guruzeta and Sannadi are injured. Nico Williams and Yuri are back in training.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.3 goals. Both coaches expect a tight game, Terzić pointing out that Osasuna's games have had few goals. Osasuna lose Oroz, their main creator, and Athletic have no striker depth, so we lean lower.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.1 corners. Athletic's direct, transition style and Arrasate's plan to go long at times balance out, so we stay with the numbers.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.9 cards. Terzić expects a game of many duels in a 'hot' El Sadar, and Athletic will hold a very high line, which tends to bring tactical fouls on the break. We lean slightly higher, though we found no recent record for referee Sesma Espinosa.

shots.text: The numbers say 24.6 shots. Nothing in the news moves the volume either way.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 7.8 shots on target. With Oroz out for Osasuna and Athletic's forward line thin, we lean a little lower on quality chances.
